| bds_in_sent_disable                           |                                                                                                                                  |
+-----------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

Disables the particular SENT channel.

 

Remarks:

 

- The information about definitions etc. can be found in the header files bds_in_ec.h and bds_in_comdef.h.
